title: LSO Paralegal Ethics & Professional Responsibilities Practice Test 1 - Ethics & Professional Responsibilities - First Action - Mixed Funds
exam: LSO Paralegal Ethics & Professional Responsibilities Practice Test 1
subject: Ethics & Professional Responsibilities

questions.q: A client writes a single cheque for $2,000 to the paralegal. $500 of this is to pay an already billed invoice, and $1,500 is an advance retainer for future work. What is the paralegal's **first action** upon receiving this cheque?
options: Deposit the entire $2,000 into the general account, and transfer $1,500 to trust later.
Cash the cheque and split the money manually.
Deposit the entire $2,000 into the mixed trust account, then transfer the earned $500 to the general account as soon as practicable.
Return the cheque to the client and demand two separate cheques.
questions.explain: Under LSO By-Law 9, when a licensee receives funds that consist of both trust money (unearned retainer) and non-trust money (earned/billed fees), the funds must be deposited into the trust account first. Once the funds clear, the non-trust portion (the $500 earned) must be withdrawn/transferred to the general account as soon as practicable.
